# apollo

local-first agent host by tsc.hk. the public site is https://apollo.tsc.hk
source: https://github.com/tschk/apollo

the desktop app (apollo-ui) is crepuscularity + gpui. it onboards a model,
a workspace, and permissions, then opens simple (chat) or advanced
(instances, tools, logs). the rotary (rx4) engine runs on the machine.
